translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: To koro ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho,
Nyasaye mane ochweyi, yaye Jakobo,
Nyasaye mane ochweyi, yaye Israel:
“Kik ibed maluor, nimar aseresi;
kendo aseluongi gi nyingi ni in mara awuon.
Ka ikadho ei pige matut,
to anabed kodi;
kendo ka ungʼado aore
to ok giniteru.
Ka uwuotho e mach mager
to ok nowangʼu,
kata mana mach makakni ok nowangʼu.
Nimar an Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasachi,
Nyasaye Maler mar Israel, ma Jawarni;
achiwo Misri gi Kush kod Seba
ka gir chudo mondo oresigo.
Nikech in ngʼat makare kendo mogen e nyima
kendo nikech aheri,
abiro chiwo ji kar loi mondo aresigo
kendo abiro chiwo ji mamoko mondo ochungʼ e loi.
Kik ibed maluor, nimar an kodi;
abiro duogo nyithindi koa yo wuok chiengʼ,
kendo abiro choko nyithindi moa yo podho chiengʼ.
Abiro wachone joma odak nyandwat ni, ‘Wegi gidhi!’
Kendo ni joma odak milambo ni, ‘Kik ugengʼ-gi.’
Keluru yawuota moa mabor
kaachiel gi nyiga koa e tunge piny,
ngʼato angʼata miluongo gi nyinga,
ngʼat mane achweyo mondo omiya duongʼ,
ngʼat mane achweyo kendo amiyo ngima.”
Keluru jogo man-gi wenge to ok nyal neno,
to bende gin gi it to ok giwinj wach.
Ogendini duto chokore kanyakla
kendo ji duto chokore kamoro achiel.
En ngʼa kuomgi mane ofwenyo gima kama kapok otimore
kendo mane owachonwa gigo mane otimore chon?
Wegiuru gikel joneno mag-gi mondo onyiswa ane ni ne gin kare,
eka joma owinjo owachi niya, “En adier.”
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “Un joneno maga ma wuoyo kuoma”
kendo jotichna ma aseyiero,
mondo mi ungʼe kendo uyie kuoma
kendo ubed gingʼeyo ni An e Nyasaye.
Onge Nyasaye moro ma nobetie kapok abet
bende onge nyasaye moro manobi bangʼe.
An e Jehova Nyasaye adier,
kendo onge jawar moro machielo makmana an.
An awuon ema asenyisou, aseresou kendo asewachonu
ni an ema asetimo magi ma ok nyiseche manono ma un-go e dieru.
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya,
“Un e joneno maga ni an e Nyasaye.”
Ee An ema asebetie nyaka aa chakruok.
Gima amako onge ngʼama nyalo golo e lweta.
En ngʼa manyalo ketho gima atimo?

content: Ngʼwono mar Nyasaye gi jo-Israel ma ok joratiro

content.text: Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye,
Jal Maler mar Israel ma jaresu wacho:
“Nikech un, abiro oro ji Babulon
mondo odhi oom jo-Babulon duto e twech,
kotingʼ-gi e yiedhi mane gisungorego.
An e Jehova Nyasaye, Jal Maler,
Jachwech Israel kendo Ruodhu.”
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho,
Jal manoloso yo e dier nam,
kendo manoketo yo e kind pi mogingore,
bende namiyo geche lweny kod farese odonjo kuno,
kaachiel gi jolweny duto maroteke,
kendo negirumo kuno ma ok gichako gitingʼo wigi
mi githo mana ka taya monegi.
Koro awachonu niya, “Goluru chunyu oko e gik machon
kendo weuru paro gik mosekadho.
Neuru, atimo gimoro manyien!
Koro osechako timore, bende unene?
Aloso yo e piny motimo ongoro
kendo aketo aore kuonde mojwangʼ.
Le mag thim ma gin
ondiegi kod tula miya duongʼ,
nikech asemiyogi pi e piny motimo ongoro
kendo aseketo aore kuonde mojwangʼ,
mondo joga mayiero oyud pi modho,
gin ji mane achweyo ne an awuon,
mondo omi gipaka.
“To kata kamano ne ok uluonga mondo akonyu, yaye Jakobo,
useol koda, yaye Israel.
Ok usechiwo rombe mondo otimnago misango miwangʼo pep,
bende ok usemiya duongʼ gi misengini magu.
Ok asemiyou tingʼ mapek mag chiwo mag cham,
kata dwaro ni uwangʼna ubani.
Ne ok ungʼiewona gimoro amora mangʼwe ngʼar,
bende ne ok udhila gi boche mag misengini.
To richou kende ema ne tura,
kendo ne uola mana gi kethou.
“An kende e jal magolo richou duto
kendo ok achak apargi nikech mano e gima ahero timo.
Parnauru gik mane otimore chon,
mondo wapim wechego kanyakla;
kendo wachuru ane gik manyiso ni uonge gi ketho.
Kwaru mokwongo notimo richo;
kendo jotendu nongʼanyona.
Kuom mano abiro kuodo wi joma tiyo ei hekalu mau,
kendo abiro jwangʼo Jakobo mondo otieki,
mi Israel yud wichkuot.”
